import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    ans = ""
    flag = False
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        if i + 2 < n - 1 and i != 0:
            temp = s[i:i+3]
            if temp == "dot":
                ans += '.'
                i += 3
                continue
            temp = s[i:i+2]
            if temp == "at" and not flag:
                ans += '@'
                i += 2
                flag = True
                continue
        elif i + 1 < n - 1 and not flag and i != 0:
            temp = s[i:i+2]
            if temp == "at" and not flag:
                ans += '@'
                i += 2
                flag = True
                continue
        ans += s[i]
        i += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
